evals.prompt: I want to start an AI startup for small businesses. Help me make a business plan and tell me what to do first.
evals.expected_output: A skeptical business-first response that narrows the vague segment, translates solution language into customer problems, identifies assumptions, and proposes customer discovery plus a 7-day plan.

evals.prompt: We are two founders with a prototype for helping accounting firms automate client document collection. We have no paying customers yet. Build a 90-day startup plan focused on business execution.
evals.expected_output: A 90-day plan covering early adopter segment, discovery, MVP/concierge test, first 10 customers, pricing hypothesis, metrics, failure risks, scale gates, and weekly actions.

evals.prompt: Our idea has 2,000 waitlist signups, so we want to hire a sales team and spend on ads. Is this the right next step?
evals.expected_output: A pushback that waitlists are weak demand, defines validation thresholds, recommends conversion/retention tests before hiring or ad scaling, and explains premature-scaling risk.

evals.prompt: Analyze why Quibi and Airbnb are useful opposite examples for someone starting a marketplace-style consumer startup.
evals.expected_output: A case-based answer that extracts transferable lessons: hair-on-fire use case, doing things that do not scale, customer pull, timing, marketplace wedge, and warnings against overfunded overbuild.
